Appendix table 6. Adults on probation, by jurisdiction, 2023

column16: Number on probation per 100,000 adult U.S. residents, December 31, 2023/a

column1: Note: Counts are rounded to the nearest 10. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. January 1 and December 31 populations include reported and imputed data from all probation agencies. Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the community supervision population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2023, does not equal the population on January 1, 2023, plus entries, minus exits. Data from 2023 are not comparable to prior years. Reporting methods for some probation agencies changed over time and probation coverage was expanded in 2023.
a/Rates were calculated using U.S. Census Bureau estimates of U.S. residents age 18 or older for January 1, 2024, in each jurisdiction.
b/January 1 and December 31 probation counts are estimates of individuals.
c/Imputed counts differ from reported counts in jurisdictions where data were not available. The Bureau of Justice Statistics imputed where data were not available. See Methodology.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2023; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2024.
